verdict.rationale: Glama explicitly markets and independently verifies (via llms.txt probe) a catalog of 90,845 MCP servers and 23,103 remote connectors, letting developers search, compare, and connect to thousands of third-party integrations. Community feedback confirms the catalog is large enough that discoverability/marketing within it is a challenge, corroborating scale rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: independent breakdown of how many of these are genuinely distinct third-party APIs/apps versus duplicate or low-quality listings.
